nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Ownable constructor and used by the onlyOwner access-control check.
Boolean pause flag, initially false; toggled by pause()/unpause() and read by the whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
Total token supply, increased by mint() and bounded by MINTING_LIMIT.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Flag disabling further minting once finishMinting() is called; read by the canMint modifier.
Constant upper bound for totalSupply enforced inside mint().
Constant token name 'BankRoi'.
Constant token symbol 'BROI'.
Constant token decimals (8).
Ownable() constructor: assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; the primary access-control gate of the contract.
Pausable() constructor, empty.
Modifier requiring !paused; applied to the token transfer and approval functions.
Modifier requiring paused; applied to unpause().
Owner-only function setting paused = true; guarded by whenNotPaused.
Owner-only function setting paused = false; guarded by whenPaused.
SafeMath.mul: computes a*b and asserts no overflow via c/a == b.
SafeMath.div: computes a/b without zero-division protection.
SafeMath.sub: asserts b <= a then returns a-b.
SafeMath.add: computes a+b and asserts c >= a.
Bankroi() constructor, empty.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting all plain Ether transfers.
Constant view returning balances[_owner].
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub/add; guarded by whenNotPaused.
Transfers _value from _from to _to using the caller's allowance; uses an implicitly typed var _allowance and SafeMath operations.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value, requiring the value to be zero or the existing allowance to be zero.
Constant view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Modifier requiring !mintingFinished.
Owner-only minting function increasing totalSupply and balances[_to], bounded by MINTING_LIMIT; guarded by canMint.
Owner-only function setting mintingFinished = true permanently.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership checks and balance debits.
Multiplication a*b inside mul with an overflow assertion.
Division a/b inside div with no zero-divisor guard.
Subtraction a-b inside sub with a b <= a assertion.
Addition a+b inside add with an overflow assertion.
require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier; the sole access-control barrier.

State writes crediting _to, debiting _from and decrementing allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
Write of allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value after the zero-allowance require check in approve.
Writes of totalSupply and balances[_to] in mint plus the MINTING_LIMIT require.

paused = false write in unpause().
mintingFinished = true write in finishMinting().

edges.reason: msg.sender is trusted implicitly and assigned as owner in the Ownable constructor.
Ownable() constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier enforces require(msg.sender == owner).
Untrusted msg.sender flows into the owner equality check.
whenNotPaused modifier reads the paused state variable.
whenPaused modifier reads the paused state variable.
canMint modifier reads the mintingFinished state variable.
pause() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
pause() is guarded by whenNotPaused.
pause() writes paused = true when authorised.
unsafe pause write updates the paused state variable.
unpause() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause() is guarded by whenPaused.
unpause() writes paused = false when authorised.
unsafe unpause write updates the paused state variable.
mul executes the multiplication a*b with an overflow assertion.
Parameter a flows into the multiplication inside mul.
Parameter b flows into the multiplication inside mul.
Local c receives the result of the multiplication in mul.
div executes the division a/b with no zero-divisor guard.
sub executes the subtraction a-b with a b <= a assertion.
add executes the addition a+b with an overflow assertion.
balanceOf parameter _owner is used to read balances.
Parameter _owner indexes the balances mapping.
transfer is guarded by the whenNotPaused modifier.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], directly trusting the caller identity.
transfer performs the balance state writes and emits Transfer.
Parameter _to receives the credited balance in transfer.
Parameter _value determines the amount moved in transfer.
msg.sender account balance is debited inside transfer.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.

transferFrom performs balance and allowance state writes and emits Transfer.
Parameter _from is debited in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is credited in transferFrom.
Parameter _value determines the amount moved in transferFrom.
Local _allowance is read from allowed[_from][msg.sender] and then decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping through the transferred allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance and allowance.
approve is guarded by the whenNotPaused modifier.
approve performs the allowance state write and emits Approval.
Parameter _spender keys the allowance entry written in approve.
Parameter _value is stored as the new allowance in approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], trusting the caller identity.
approve updates the allowed mapping state variable.
allowance parameter _owner indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance parameter _spender indexes the allowed mapping.
Parameter _owner reads the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter _spender reads the allowed mapping in allowance.
mint is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint is guarded by the canMint modifier.
mint writes totalSupply and balances[_to] under owner authorisation.
Parameter _to receives the newly minted balance.
Parameter _amount increases totalSupply and balances[_to].
mint updates totalSupply using SafeMath.add bounded by MINTING_LIMIT.
mint credits balances[_to] through the balances mapping.
mint calls SafeMath.add for totalSupply and balance updates.
finishMinting is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
finishMinting permanently writes mintingFinished = true.
finishMinting updates the mintingFinished state variable.
Fallback function reverts, so no fallback dataflow reaches any state variable.
